name: Should I consider property management for a cash flow property?

mainEntity.name: Should I consider property management for a cash flow property?

acceptedAnswer.text: Considering property management is often a practical tradeoff, especially for out-of-state investors or those with limited time. While it adds an expense (typically 8-12% of gross monthly rent), it can save time, ensure professional tenant screening, handle maintenance, and manage legal aspects. This allows you to focus on portfolio growth. Our team can help connect you with reputable property management services in the South Florida region, offering a first-party insight into local options.
acceptedAnswer.description: Property management adds expense but saves time, handles tenant screening, maintenance, and legal aspects, often a good tradeoff for busy investors.
